notes.title: Fixed several wrong translations.
notes.content: Fixed some wrong translations in English, Spanish and Chinese.

notes.title: Updates, including additional languages
notes.content:
[b]Language Addition[/b]
 Spanish has been added
 Simplified Chinese added
 Traditional Chinese added

[b]Fixes[/b]
 Fixed a bug where achievements unlocked are not shown in the game
 Fixed English expressions to be more natural

notes.title: Various updates including new content
notes.content:
[b]The new content "Girls' night out in the Attic" has been implemented![/b]
 You can enter by collecting the stars you earn in the stage.
 You can enjoy the conversation between Tia and Doll.

[b]A rating system has been implemented for stages[/b]
 If you clear the stage in the best possible way, you will receive ★3.
 After that, the number of ★ will decrease every time you spend a turn.

Conversation skipping has been implemented
Clicking has been added to card operations
Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: Fixed display on wide monitor.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the screen to collapse on wide monitors
Fixed to show the number of stages
